'''Zephee''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] of [[Bright Tree Village/Legends|Bright Tree Village]] on the [[Endor/Legends|forest moon]] of [[Endor (planet)/Legends|Endor]]. By the final [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Era]], she was the [[Marriage/Legends|wife]] of [[Lumat/Legends|Lumat]] and the [[Parent/Legends|mother]] of [[Latara/Legends|Latara]], [[Nippet/Legends|Nippet]], and [[Wiley (Ewok)|Wiley]].<ref name="DB Nippet">{{DB|character|nippet|Nippet}}</ref> In [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], when the [[Heroes of Yavin/Legends|Heroes of Yavin]] were presented to the Bright Tree tribe following their capture, Zephee stood observing from afar at the entrance of a hut.<ref name="rotj" /> Zephee had [[Color/Legends|gray]] [[Hair/Legends|fur]] and black [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], and she often wore a red hood with beads.<ref name="THV" /> Occasionally, she also wore a black hood.<ref name="rotj" /> Zephee shared her name with a [[Zephee (spirit)|wind spirit]] from Ewok mythology.<ref name="GCG">''[[Galactic Campaign Guide]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|It certainly wasn't much fun being an Ewok, either at Elstree or in the forest while we were shooting. Every so often, on the set, we had to peel them out of their suits and take off their specially designed sets of underwear, because they would be soaking wet, and send them (the underwear, not the Ewoks!) off to the laundry while they put on a spare set. I have a lot of respect for their endurance.|[[Howard G. Kazanjian]]|<ref name="CM">{{SWArchive|url=episode-vi/explore/classic/2002/11/classic20021120.html|text=Episode VI Classic Moment - Not Easy Being Cute}}</ref>}}
[[File:Maternal_ewok.jpg|thumb|left|Production photo of the Ewok that would later be known as Zephee]]
Zephee first appeared in the [[1984]] children's book ''[[The Baby Ewoks' Picnic Surprise]]'', where she was only known as "Mama Ewok."<ref name="BEPS">''[[The Baby Ewoks' Picnic Surprise]]''</ref> Her name first appeared as the name of a figure from the short-lived [[Wicket the Ewok (toy line)|''Wicket the Ewok'']] toy line in 1984,<ref name="Woktots">{{WebCite|url=http://blog.theswca.com/2017/10/woktots-kenners-preschool-star-wars-toys.html|text=Woktots: Kenner's Preschool Star Wars Toys|work=Star Wars Collectors Archive Blog|archivedate=20220520010210}}</ref> and that same year [[Kenner Products|Kenner]] catalogs listed Zephee as an upcoming addition to the company's line of stuffed Ewok toys. The stuffed toy would have been larger than the others and include backpack for carrying Woklings. Despite its appearance in the catalog and on tags of earlier stuffed Ewoks, the toy was never released.<ref name="STA">{{WebCite|url=https://www.toyarchive.com/Starwars/StuffedEwokZephee.html|text=Unproduced Zephee Stuffed Ewok|work=Super Toy Archive|archiveurl=https://archive.is/4Ybgw}}</ref>

She appeared in [[Ewoks (television series)|''Ewoks'']], an animated television series that ran from [[1985]] to [[1986]],<ref name="MTE">{{SW|url=news/meet-the-ewoks-from-endor|text=Yub Yub: Meet the Ewoks from Endor|int=Yub Yub: Meet the Ewoks from Endor|nolive=1}}</ref> but her character name was not mentioned until the book ''[[The Haunted Village (book)|The Haunted Village]]'',<ref name="HVBooK">[[The Haunted Village (book)|''The Haunted Village'' picture book]]</ref> which was released on [[September 24]], [[1987]] as an adaptation<ref name="Amazon">{{Amazon|url=Haunted-Village/dp/0583311644|text=Haunted Village}}</ref> of the episode with the [[The Haunted Village|same name]].<ref name="THV" />

In [[2013]], however, Zephee was [[Retroactive continuity|retconned]] into [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']], when the digital card game ''[[Star Wars: Force Collection]]'' used a production photo of an Ewok holding a wokling.<ref name="FC">{{ForceCollection|Zephee|star=3}}</ref> Said picture had notably appeared on the [[StarWars.com]] site as part of the [[Episode VI Classic Moments]] feature.<ref name="CM" /> Although that particular Ewok cannot be seen holding a wokling in the final cut of the film, she can still be spotted in the background, wearing a white belt at the entrance of a hut and scratching her right ear.<ref name="rotj" />
